error.message: The triage request fails anchor-tuning-request.schema.json, although anchor_tuning_contract.py request passes. At $.authority.anchors.records[0] (ANC-022 v4), the required property 'state' is missing; the schema requires state == 'locked'. Also at $.authority.anchors.records[0].source_ref, null is not of type 'string'. Without state the payload does not show that ANC-022 is a locked, normative record, so triage stops here and returns no disposition.
error.suggested_action: Re-render the request with anchor-tuning-review-feedback.md.j2 using sc-compose render --strict --check-render. In the ANC-022 record, set "state": "locked" (anchors.json has status 'locked') and drop source_ref or give it a string value. Then validate against anchor-tuning-request.schema.json and with anchor_tuning_contract.py request, and dispatch triage again. Keep the same evidence and sealed set (b2a1f73bcfb3ea27dda58605a24e82c90b7e29a33cc409c68fae08d37bda84f5).
